description: Consumption and growth continue while ecological degradation inequality and infrastructure fragility deepen.
Institutions coordinate climate action ecological restoration public investment social protection and adaptive governance.
Wealthier actors adapt while vulnerable communities face exposure displacement and underinvestment.
Innovation accelerates emissions reduction and monitoring but justice and governance remain uneven.
Extreme events overwhelm public systems and reveal weak institutions and low adaptive capacity.
Regions rebuild food water energy ecological and community systems around resilience and repair.
Low-carbon investment expands but benefits are captured unevenly and extraction continues.
Ecological integrity social justice public capacity and institutional learning reinforce one another.
